summary: Add native 30-day dotfiles GO-to-merged completion ratio declarations for the 600-second p50 and 1800-second p95 goals, excluding labelled admission proxies; honor inclusive bad-share targets at the exact allowance boundary

replay.detail: Existing custom claims and the native incremental ratio reader reconstruct evaluations after restart or declaration revision. Completion identity and mergedAt remain stable across producer replay. No new projection or replay kind.

schema.detail: Uses existing objective declarations, custom claim fields and /v1/claims. No registered kind, generated schema, database migration, inventory entry or route.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or convergence rules change.

compatibility.detail: An eligible horizon exactly at its bad-share allowance no longer reports exhausted solely for equality; it satisfies the displayed inclusive bound with zero remaining budget. Existing unknown and paired-burn rules remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; the new objective source is not automatically published.

manual.detail: Publish slo/dotfiles-merge-latency.kdl through the owning fleet declaration source and ingest durable queue-derived custom.landing.dotfiles-merged facts through the existing claim interface. No live observer or queue activation is included.

recovery.detail: Republish the previous owning source to withdraw the two declarations. Existing custom fact claims remain available for replay. An older binary retains its previous allowance-equality classification.
